title: Without Delete, a user can still rename a part stocked at two locations
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a custom role for this test, role B, with Part Library & Inventory — View, Part Library & Inventory — Create & Edit and See Financial Data but without Part Library & Inventory — Delete, so user B can create and edit parts but cannot delete them.
  • Create a staff member for this test, user B, at the test location with role B, so the steps run with role B's permissions.
  • Use two browser windows: window 1 signed in as the Admin, window 2 (a private window) signed in as user B, so both users' screens can be seen side by side.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test at the test location and at location B under the same part number, so both share one Part Library entry.
  • Use a new description, description 2, that no part uses.
  • Start window 2 on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. In window 2, click the part A row.
  2. In window 2, replace the Description with description 2.
  3. In window 2, click Save.
  4. In window 1, pick location B in the location selector at the top right.
  5. In window 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  6. In window 1, click Inventory in the left menu.
  7. In window 1, type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 2:

  • Under the Description field: "This also changes the description at 1 other location."

Step 3:

  • The window closes and the change is saved with no access error, although user B cannot delete and the change reaches location B.

Step 4:

  • The location selector shows location B.

Step 5:

  • Window 1 shows the Parts left menu.

Step 6:

  • Location B's Inventory page opens.

Step 7:

  • Part A now reads description 2 at location B.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S8-R11: “Changing a part's number or description needs only the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission, including when the change reaches other locations.”
  • S13-R12: “When the user changes the description and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the description at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the description at 1 other location." for one.”
  • Key Decisions: “The number and description are shared. They live on the part's Part Library entry, which every location that stocks the part shares. Editing them at one location changes them at every location, and the dialog says so before the save (S13-R12, S13-R16).”
